The season began on 17 July 2017 and was scheduled to end in May 2018. Ten teams competed throughout the entire season. ==Teams== [[Sociedad Deportiva Atlético Nacional|Atlético Nacional]] finished in 10th place in the overall table last season and were relegated to the [[Liga Nacional de Ascenso]].
